description.html:
Description:

We are looking for a skilled and motivated WordPress Developer to design, develop, maintain, and optimize WordPress websites. The ideal candidate should have knowledge of WordPress themes, plugins, website customization, and responsive web design.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain WordPress websites.
  • Customize WordPress themes and plugins according to project requirements.
  • Design responsive and user-friendly web pages.
  • Manage website updates, backups, security, and performance.
  • Troubleshoot website issues and fix technical errors.
  • Optimize websites for speed, SEO, and mobile devices.
  • Work with the team to deliver projects on time.

Requirements:

  • Knowledge of WordPress website development.
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.
  • Experience with WordPress themes, plugins, and page builders.
  • Basic understanding of website security and SEO.
  • Good problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Fresh candidates with relevant skills and experienced candidates may apply.

Interested candidates can visit ApneJob.com to explore job opportunities and apply.

How to Apply:

Website: https://apnejob.com/

Mobile Number:03166603880

Email: info@apnejob.com
